notes.value:
Vol. 3 has subtitle: Abstracts of the Ketubot or marriage-contracts and of the civil marriage registers of the Spanish and Portuguese Jews Congregation for the period 1837-1901; with an introd. and an index by G. H. Whitehill.
Vol. 4 has subtitle: The circumcision register of Isaac and Abraham de Paiba (1715-1775). Transcribed, translated, and edited by R.D. Barnett ; together with a supplement including a record of circumcisions 1679-99, marriages 1679-89, and some female births 1679-99, compiled by Miriam Rodrigues-Pereira.
Vol. 5 has subtitle: The birth register (1767-1881) of the Spanish & Portuguese Jews' Congregation, London ... and including the Jewish births (1707-1763) in the 18th-century Register books of the College of Arms ...
Vol. 6 has subtitle: The burial register (1733-1918) of the novo (new) cemetery of the Spanish & Portuguese Jews' Congregation, London (with some later entries).
Vol. 2 has imprint: Oxford, printed at the University press by C. Batey; vol. 3-<4   > have imprint: London, published jointly by the Spanish and Portuguese Jews' Congregation and the Jewish Historical Society of England.
